title: Gangaridai
note: Reference entry by A. M. Chowdhury. It summarizes classical Greek and Latin mentions, offers a tentative geographic reading of Ptolemy, and expressly states that local evidence does not establish a Bengal kingdom matching those accounts around the beginning of the Common Era.
whyItMatters: The entry distinguishes what classical writers report from what can be established locally, and cautions that Ptolemy's location and the city of Gange remain uncertain.
